description: This file defines internal metadata handling functions for gRPC, including setting, getting, and validating metadata associated with network addresses.

classes.name: mdKeyType
classes.description: Type alias for string, used as key type for metadata in address attributes.

classes.name: mdValue
classes.description: Type alias for metadata.MD, with an equality method for comparison.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Compares two mdValue instances for equality.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates all key-value pairs in a metadata.MD.

methods.name: hasNotPrintable
methods.description: Checks if a string contains non-printable ASCII characters.

methods.name: ValidateKey
methods.description: Validates a header key against allowed characters and format.

methods.name: ValidatePair
methods.description: Validates a key-value pair in metadata, including key format and value printability.
